verdict.rationale: Docs confirm DeepInfra lets users deploy their own fine-tuned LLM weights on dedicated GPU instances (A100/H100/H200/B200/B300) with autoscaling and private endpoints, and offers raw GPU clusters with SSH for full custom control, covering the 'custom model weights' part of the story. However, there is no explicit mention of LoRA adapter upload/serving specifically, nor details on the upload workflow, supported formats, or serving mechanics beyond marketing-level claims. missing for 10: explicit LoRA adapter support/upload workflow, technical details on weight upload process, independent/hands-on confirmation of custom deployment working.
